subject: Discovery recap & PoC timeline - Integration & Onboarding
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Agarwal <samir@fastretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap & PoC timeline - Integration & Onboarding

Hi Samir (and Priya),

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed PoC/onboarding plan so we're aligned on next steps. Please reply with any corrections or missing details.

Key pain points you shared:
- End-user latency spikes on the personalized recommendations endpoint during peak traffic (especially 99th percentile tail).
- High per-request cost from current vendor for high-volume inference (esp. multi-turn dialogs and reranks).
- Operational complexity: managing multiple model variants and routing rules across regions.

Current stack and constraints:
- Production microservices on AWS (Node.js) calling external LLM APIs for recommendation generation; offline batch jobs in Python for model scoring.
- Data residency requirement: US-only for PII-sensitive signals.
- SOC 2 & procurement checklist required before production.

Success criteria for the PoC:
1) 99th percentile latency <= 200ms for the recommendation endpoint under a representative load.
2) >= 30% reduction in cost per 100k tokens compared to current baseline, while maintaining output quality.
3) Clear integration path (Node + Python SDKs) and a plan for routing/fallbacks.

Proposed PoC timeline (4 weeks):
- Week 0 (Kickoff): access & credentials, test accounts, baseline metrics collection.
- Week 1: SDK integration (Node service) + smoke tests in staging.
- Week 2: Load testing and latency tuning (batching/caching config).
- Week 3: Quality validation & cost analysis vs baseline.
- Week 4: Final evaluation, decision & next steps for Dedicated/private deployment if needed.

Owners & roles:
- Marissa (AE) — program owner, timeline coordination.
- Ben (SE) — technical onboarding, load test & tuning.
- Dev Patel (Engineering) — primary FastRetail integration contact.

Ask / next steps:
- Can you confirm the success criteria and the proposed timeline?
- Please share staging access (or a staging contact) and an initial baseline export for the recommendation endpoint (1–2 representative traces).
- We’ll prepare a PoC checklist and a short SOW doc; attaching a high-level PoC-MAP for reference.

Attachments: PoC-MAP.xlsx (high-level milestones)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Samir / Marissa — looping in the technical onboarding plan from our side and a few specifics so Priya and Dev have what they need for the kickoff. Attaching the Redwood integration guide.

High-level tech notes:
- API compatibility: Redwood exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST API for generation/chat and a separate embeddings endpoint; we also provide official Node (v2.x) and Python (v1.x) SDKs.
- SDKs: Node example (npm install @redwoodai/sdk):
  const { Redwood } = require('@redwoodai/sdk');
  const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
  const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-2-small', input: prompt });

- Python example (pip install redwood-sdk):
  from redwood import Redwood
  client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
  res = client.generate(model='redwood-2-small', input=prompt)

- Auth & keys: For the PoC we'll provide scoped API keys (staging) with usage limits. For Dedicated/private we'll discuss KMS integrations.
- Data handling: We support region-scoped deployments (US) and can enable strict logging/data retention policies to satisfy SOC 2 requirements.

Proposed milestone dates (concrete):
- Kickoff & creds (owner: Priya / Marissa) — 2026-06-28
- SDK integration (owner: Dev Patel + FastRetail eng team) — 2026-06-29 to 2026-07-05
- Load testing & tuning (owner: Ben) — 2026-07-06 to 2026-07-12
- Quality & cost eval (owner: Marissa/Ben) — 2026-07-13 to 2026-07-18
- PoC wrap & exec review — 2026-07-20

Deliverables we need from FastRetail before kickoff:
1) Staging endpoint/creds or a contact to provision a testing workspace.
2) Baseline traces (1 day) — Samir said EOD Thursday.
3) Expected QPS and representative payload sizes for the recommendation endpoint.

Attachments: redwood-integration-guide.pdf (contains SDK links, sample cURLs, and load-test templates)
